mechanism: Polyethylene glycol solutions can cause osmotic diuresis and volume depletion, which may potentiate empagliflozin's diuretic effects and increase risk of dehydration and acute kidney injury.
action: Ensure adequate hydration and monitor renal function when polyethylene glycol (typically used for bowel preparation) is administered in patients taking empagliflozin; consider temporary discontinuation of empagliflozin during bowel preparation.
